title: Prior Period Comparison with LAG()
realWorldScenario: Finance needs to calculate invoice-over-invoice growth and detect any billing discrepancies for organization 101.
questionStatement: Write a query on `invoices` for `organization_id = 101` returning `id`, `billing_date`, `amount`, and `prev_amount` (the amount of the immediately prior invoice using `LAG()`). Order results by `billing_date` ascending.
starterCode:
-- Calculate prior invoice amount with LAG
SELECT
  id,
  billing_date,
  amount,
  LAG(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY billing_date ASC) AS prev_amount
FROM invoices
WHERE organization_id = 101
ORDER BY billing_date ASC;
hints: LAG(column, offset) looks backward in the sorted window.

testCases.description: Verify prior invoice amounts for organization 101
